events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, the legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began in Bethel, New York, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Legacy of peace & music
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. What's your favourite iconic performance from the festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The world lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, on this day in 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: 49 years since the King left the building. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations. What's your top track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: The legendary Chrissie Hynde is 75 today! Still rocking, still iconic. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid is 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 64 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday, born in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... John Lennon would have been 86 today. His message of peace and love lives on. What's your favourite Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost the incomparable showman and Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the voice of a generation. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?
